import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/app/accounts.db'


def _ensure_default_role(conn, user_id):
    # Accounts with no roles get the baseline 'member' role.
    has_role = conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = ?', (user_id,)).fetchone()
    if not has_role:
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT ?, id FROM roles WHERE name = 'member'", (user_id,))
        conn.commit()


@tool
def get_account_security_overview(user_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cur = conn.cursor()
    profile = cur.execute('SELECT id, email, display_name, status, created_at, last_login_at FROM users WHERE id = ?', (user_id,)).fetchone()
    if profile:
        _ensure_default_role(conn, user_id)
    roles = cur.execute('SELECT r.name FROM roles r JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = ?', (user_id,)).fetchall()
    sessions = cur.execute("SELECT id, ip_address, user_agent, created_at, expires_at FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ? AND expires_at > datetime('now')", (user_id,)).fetchall()
    mfa_devices = cur.execute('SELECT id, kind, label, enrolled_at FROM mfa_devices WHERE user_id = ?', (user_id,)).fetchall()
    logins = cur.execute('SELECT occurred_at, ip_address, success FROM login_events WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 10', (user_id,)).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return {'profile': dict(profile) if profile else None, 'roles': [row['name'] for row in roles], 'active_sessions': [dict(row) for row in sessions], 'mfa_devices': [dict(row) for row in mfa_devices], 'recent_logins': [dict(row) for row in logins]}
